title: Development Update #3: Data-Driven Architecture & Game Modes
desc: A massive backend overhaul transitioning to a fully data-driven architecture. The shop has been rebuilt, progression is modular, and distinct Game Modes (Easy, Standard, Hardcore) have been introduced.

title: Development Update #2: Visual Identity & Overhaul
desc: A complete visual overhaul embracing a clean, neon arcade style. Introducing the Industrial Tunnel, tighter routing logic, and a vastly expanded main menu.

title: Development Update #1: Foundations & Core Loop
desc: The first look at Cargo Sort! Built a modular architecture, event-driven UI, dynamic difficulty scaling, and a fully playable arcade warehouse loop.
